author: tbolt
description: A personal cold-vault portfolio for crypto holdings. Track coins across multiple locations (exchanges, cold wallets, hardware), with live CoinGecko pricing, manual balance entry, and an AI-free, server-side autosave to your NAS. Data lives on your NAS.
tagline: Track crypto holdings across locations, self-hosted

tips.before_install:
## Cold Vault

Data (coin holdings, wallet locations, portfolio, AI-free server-side autosave) is stored on your ZimaOS disk at `/DATA/AppData/cold-vault/`, so it survives container rebuilds and is shared across every browser on your network.

title: Cold Vault
release_note: - Initial release: self-hosted crypto cold-vault portfolio.
